title: CLI Task Manager & Log Analyzer
descriptionMarkdown:
In this milestone project, you will combine File I/O, Collections, Streams, Multithreading, and Software Architecture. You will build a command-line tool that parses text-based log files concurrently, filters data using Streams, and stores the results using a structured Strategy pattern.

This consolidates all 6 weeks of Java 21 fundamentals into a real-world, executable utility.
learningObjectives: Design a scalable application architecture using SOLID principles
Process files using Java I/O streams and Streams API
Manage concurrency with Java standard library tools
Implement the Builder and Strategy design patterns
